description: Round9 Canada temporal backfill pass limited to CA rows with recommended_action=research_temporal_dates. This runtime-safe pass excludes GNBC/NRCan documented-by or decision-date records as operational start dates unless corroborated by a credible establishment, opening, active, closure, or clearly dated official use-window source.
skipped_notes: No new runtime-safe Canada candidates were found for the current CA research_temporal_dates rows.
The current queue/gap rows are Pelly Island/Nipterk Base plus twelve Canadian Forces range/training-area place-name records.
Round8 already identified the range rows as GNBC/NRCan decision-date/documented-by evidence; the Round9 constraint explicitly excludes those dates from operational start-date use.

Pelly Island/Nipterk Base remains skipped because available hits did not provide credible military establishment/opening/active/closure evidence, and prior passes found only generic place-name, mapping, weather, oil/exploration, or non-military northern-site context.

Cedar Springs Range has a runtime-safe 1912 establishment source from Canada.ca, but it is not in the current CA recommended_action=research_temporal_dates scope and was already isolated in the Round8 runtime-safe report.
